summary: Iteration 29: Verified VISITA PIN suggestions + assign/change flow end-to-end on the internal Applications page. Backend GET /api/internal/visita-pin/suggestions returns 5 unique unused 4-digit strings; count clamped to 1..10 (count=50 -> 10; count=3 -> 3); requires auth (401/403 without token). POST /api/internal/applications/{id}/assign-pin: 200 with {ok:true, visita_patient_id, changed:true} on valid new pin; updates patients.visita_patient_id + linked patient_directory.visita_patient_id + application.created_visita_patient_id; releases the old PIN (verified by re-assigning old PIN back = 200); 400 for '12' and 'abcd'; 409 when the requested PIN is already used by another patient; 404 for unknown application id. Frontend: staff login -> Applications -> New Patients filter shows PIN panels on ACCEPTED new_patient cards. Change PIN button opens editor, 5 suggested chips render, clicking chip fills the manual input, Save calls the API, editor closes, and app-pin-current updates to the new PIN. Manual input strips non-digits and caps at 4 chars (typed 'ab12cd34ef' -> '1234'). Invalid 2-digit save is blocked client-side with a toast 'VISITA PIN must be a 4-digit number.'; PIN does not change. WAITING_LIST filter tab (app-filter-WAITING_LIST) still present (iter-28 regression preserved). Backend pytest 12/12 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py suggestions endpoint builds full 9000-int pool + shuffles each call - fine at current scale but O(n) memory each call; consider random sampling with retry when 'used' is small.

assign-pin uniqueness check across patients + directory + visita_pins is good but the 3 lookups + upsert + 2 updates + delete are not wrapped in a transaction. If the process crashes mid-way the PIN could be claimed in visita_pins but not written to patients. Consider a Mongo multi-document txn or an idempotent reconciler.

Frontend openPin() sets pinVal to created_visita_patient_id but the Save button will accept saving the SAME pin (backend returns changed:false 200). UX still OK but consider disabling Save when pinVal === current.

openPin() calls suggestions endpoint every time editor opens - fine but no loading spinner beyond 'Loading suggestions…' text; consider disabling Save until suggestions or manual 4-digit input is ready.
